result.messageUz: Bu reklama 8 soniyali Instagram uchun yaratiladi, yoshlar uchun moʻljallangan. Toʻq kulrang paxta futbolka koʻkrak qismida sariq dumaloq logotip bilan koʻrsatiladi. Tabiiy muhitda, zamonaviy kundalik kiyimda koʻrsatish orqali eʻtibor jalb qilinadi.

fidelityConstraints: sariq dumaloq logotip koʻkrak qismida joylashgan boʻlishi kerak
futbolka qisqa yengli va oddiy shaklda boʻlishi kerak

concept.titleUz: Oddiy, qulay va yorqin logotip bilan JN futbolkasi
concept.rationaleUz: Yoshlar orasida kundalik kiyim sifatida tanilgan, qulay va tabiiy matodan tayyorlangan futbolka sifatida namoyish qilish. Sariq dumaloq logotip mahsulot identifikatsiyasini kuchaytiradi.
concept.hookUz: Toʻq kulrang futbolka qirqilgan koʻrinishda, koʻkrakda sariq dumaloq logotip aniq koʻrinmoqda.
concept.ctaUz: JN futbolkasini hoziroq sinab koʻring va oʻzingizga qulay kiyim toping!

shots.descriptionUz: Toʻq kulrang futbolka, logotip koʻrinishini diqqat bilan koʻrsatuvchi sekin push-in kamera harakati.
Model futbolkani kiyib, kundalik muhitda harakatlanmoqda, futbolka va logotip koʻrinadi.
Model logotip sohasiga kamera qaratib turibdi, futbolka toʻliq koʻrinishda, oxirgi aniqlik beriladi.

result.promptEn: The supplied visual reference is the sole authority for the product's appearance. This product is a dark gray cotton T-shirt featuring a short sleeve and a distinct yellow circular logo on the chest area displaying 'JN.' The advertisement should avoid changing these specific design elements. The commercial concept focuses on portraying the T-shirt as a stylish, comfortable lifestyle product for young adults. The creative direction is lifestyle, shot in a natural everyday urban environment reflecting modern youth culture. Begin with a slow push-in on the T-shirt laid flat or on a mannequin, clearly showing the dark gray fabric and yellow circular logo. The camera then follows a young adult model putting on and casually moving wearing the T-shirt in a believable setting such as a city street or park, emphasizing the fit and material texture without fast or aggressive movements. Lighting is natural but bright enough to show the texture and color fidelity of the cotton fabric and the vivid yellow logo. The material should appear soft, matte cotton, with gentle shadows to highlight texture. The sequence shows: 1) close flat detail of the fabric and logo, 2) medium shot of the model in motion, 3) close focus on the logo area with calm final emphasis. Transitions are direct cuts to maintain clarity and keep pacing steady but relaxed within the 8-second limit. Audio is natural ambient city sound and soft fabric movement noise, no music or voiceover. The hero ending is a clean framing of the model looking towards or interacting with the camera with the T-shirt clearly visible. Visual quality should be clean, lifelike, and true to the reference colors without artificial enhancement. Fidelity requirements: no change in the dark gray color, the yellow logo shape and position must be preserved exactly, and no added graphics or text overlays apart from the physical logo visible in the reference. Avoid fast camera moves, changes in fabric color or texture, unnecessary zooms, or shots that cut off the T-shirt or logo. This prompt aims to build a clear, relatable lifestyle image of the JN T-shirt for Instagram youth awareness.
assumptionsUz: Model kiyim sifatida futbolkani kiygani tasvirlanadi.
Futbolka matosi yumshoq paxta kabi koʻrsatildi.
Logotip matodan alohida qoʻyilgan, sifatli rangli tasvirda saqlanadi.
reviewNotesUz: Rang va logotip aniq koʻrinishi juda muhim.
Model va muhit yoshlar uchun jozibador boʻlishi zarur.
Video dinamikasi juda tez yoki agressiv boʻlmasligi kerak.
